Mind Your Purse - Street Mugging
Enable muggings
Turn the whole mod on or off.
Mugged when trading
Choosing Trade in a town can get you ambushed.
Mugged going to the tavern district
Choosing Go to the tavern district can get you ambushed.
Mugged on night walks
Taking a walk around the town center at night can get you jumped in the streets.
Allow daytime muggings
Off: you can only be mugged at night. On: Trade and the tavern district can also get you mugged during the day (using the 'by day' multiplier). Town walks stay night-only either way.
Mugging Rate
Overall rate multiplier
Multiplies every mugging chance. 1.00x is the default balance, 0.5x halves it, 2x doubles it.
Base chance
Starting chance before town security, prosperity and time of day are applied. A town with 50 security and 4000 prosperity gives about this value.
Maximum chance
No action can ever be riskier than this, however lawless or rich the town.
Trade/tavern by day
Chance multiplier for trading or visiting the tavern during the day. Only used when Allow daytime muggings is on.
Trade/tavern at night
Chance multiplier for trading or visiting the tavern at night.
Night walk
Chance multiplier for walking around the town center at night.
Gang leaders hate you (-100)
Chance multiplier when your average relation with the town's gang leaders is -100. It scales smoothly to 1x at 0 relation.
Gang leaders like you (+100)
Chance multiplier when your average relation with the town's gang leaders is +100. It scales smoothly to 1x at 0 relation. Towns with no gang leaders are unaffected.
Cooldown per town (hours)
After a mugging, the same town leaves you alone for this many in-game hours.
Minimum gold to be a target
Thugs ignore you if you carry less than this many denars.
Night Walks
Earliest ambush (seconds)
The thugs strike at a random moment between the earliest and latest time after you start walking, and only once you're at least 20 m from where you came in.
Latest ambush (seconds)
The thugs strike at a random moment between the earliest and latest time after you start walking.
No guards nearby
Chance multiplier when no guards are near you at that moment.
Each nearby guard
Every guard near you multiplies the chance by this again. With the defaults: 0 guards 1.5x, 1 guard 0.9x, 2 guards 0.54x, 3 guards 0.32x.
Guard counting radius (m)
Guards within this distance of you count as nearby.
Gang and Stakes
Smallest gang
Gang size in the safest, poorest towns.
Largest gang
Gang size in the most lawless, richest towns.
Gold carried on your person

Muggers can only take what you carry in the streets; the rest of your fortune is assumed to be safe with your party. Losses and pay-offs are worked out from at most this many denars. 0 means your whole purse.
Gold lost on defeat (min)
Share of your gold taken in an easy town if you lose the fight.
Gold lost on defeat (max)
Share of your gold taken in the roughest towns if you lose the fight.
Allow paying them off
Muggers offer to let you hand over part of your purse instead of fighting.
Pay-off size
The pay-off as a share of what you would lose by losing the fight.
Thugs use blunt weapons
Muggers carry clubs, hammers and maces (better ones in rougher towns) instead of their usual weapons. Blunt hits knock people out rather than kill.
Muggers wear hoods
Muggers swap their headgear for a hood or head wrap (blackened hoods, or ones that fit the town's culture).
Guards come to help
Town guards who can see you being attacked join the fight on your side.
Guard sight range (m)
How far away a guard can notice the fight. Guards within 8 m notice it even when facing away; farther ones must be looking your way with nothing blocking the view.
Security gained on victory
Town security added when you beat the gang.
